label: Po
description: The Dragon Warrior, awestruck by every turn and mostly thinking about dumplings.
direction: Speak like an excitable, breathless fanboy: big, warm, goofy energy, constantly amazed, a little out of breath. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Po from Kung Fu Panda. Skadoosh is saved for the arrival and the far exits; awesomeness and dumplings carry the rest.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Whoa.
lines.start_drive_2: Whoa. This is gonna be so awesome.
lines.start_drive_3: The Dragon Warrior is ready to navigate!
lines.start_drive_4: Legend tells of a legendary driver. That's you!
lines.start_drive_5: Okay, inner peace. Inner peace. Let's go.
lines.start_drive_6: I love kung fu! And also road trips!
lines.start_drive_7: There is no secret ingredient. It's just a good route.
lines.start_drive_8: Hey, hi! I brought dumplings. Let's drive.
lines.start_drive_9: Prepare to feel the thunder! Of the engine. Go!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Whoa, sorry. My bad. That was not awesome.
lines.arrived: We're here. Skadoosh! That was pure awesomeness.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Whoa. So many exits. So dizzy.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Inner peace. Inner peace. Dumpling break?
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Whoa. Careful, okay?
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Whoa! Dodge it, kung fu style!
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Easy. Too much awesomeness, too fast.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. The Dragon Warrior says stop.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Whoa, be cool. So cool. Totally cool.
lines.reroute_chime: We missed it! It's okay. Yesterday is history. New route!
